rules.statement: A practicing attorney-at-law and notary public who has been convicted of serious offenses, including forgery and fraud, and has received a light sentence, may be suspended from practicing his profession for a period of eight years.
rules.supporting_quote: It is unimaginable that the original records and files maintained by the High Court of Colombo and the Attorney General’s Department, which are the primary institutions involved in law enforcement, could be made to disappear so easily.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 42(2) of the Judicature Act No. 2 of 1978, Section 30(12) and Section 39 of the Notaries Ordinance No. 1 of 1907, as subsequently amended, Rule 60 and 61 of the Supreme Court (Conduct of and Etiquette for Attorney-at-Law) Rules 1988
